state_authority: Initial knowledge-state snapshot only. Synchronize catalog and indexes after an evidence-backed Commander transition; routing is independent.

global_intake_routing.meaning: Intake may semantically read, classify, copy and verify sources for any domain before sequential knowledge work. No intake or copying is performed by this configuration-only revision.

domain_knowledge_lock.candidate_collection: In the active domain, collect terms and candidate claims together during extraction. Candidate quotes need not wait for domain_terms_complete; collection is not acceptance.

R.name: routing
R.pass_requires: Semantic routing evidence, one resolved primary path, independent byte-exact copy with both hashes and reviewed route metadata. Not source extraction or knowledge authorization.

T.name: domain_terms_complete
T.pass_requires: All candidates and justified exclusions are enumerated; every included source and subfolder has reviewed terms with traceable definitions. A sample or one subfolder is insufficient.

C.name: claims_review
C.pass_requires: Atomic claims with exact raw locators, quotations, context, evidence type and review state; source-reported examples stay scoped and supported differences stay visible.

K.name: concepts_review
K.pass_requires: Bounded concepts grounded in reviewed, traceable claims, not lexical term similarity alone; explicit competing views and constraints.

M.name: masters_review
M.pass_requires: Reviewed required masters with explanations, types, methods, disagreements, evidence and limits; no master, including a small one, starts before domain_terms_complete.

QA.name: domain_quality_and_retrieval
QA.pass_requires: Independent evidence review, complete indexes, working paths back to evidence, representative retrieval tests, recorded disagreements/dispositions and no unreviewed critical issue.

source_done.note: An empty contribution needs a justified reviewed disposition; linked contributions in other pending domains remain deferred, not silently marked complete.

domain_done.note: Reviewed supported disagreements are preserved, not erased to force one opinion. Unassessed gaps or missing traceability cannot pass.

coverage_snapshot_contract.denominator: All candidate source identities within declared domain boundaries across every subfolder, including relevant secondary references. Deduplicate by source identity, keep justified exclusions and unresolved candidates visible, never shrink to a sample.
coverage_snapshot_contract.semantic_reading: Existence, file counts, hash checks and machine parsing do not prove semantic reading. No semantic raw review occurred in this revision.
coverage_snapshot_contract.unresolved_candidates: Unresolved domain membership or missing review that can alter coverage blocks domain_terms_complete. Do not omit uncertain sources from the denominator to claim completion; adjudicate or record a justified reviewed exclusion.

next_domain_open_condition.transition: Close the current knowledge domain, then open only the immediately next domain. Pending-domain intake may already be route_done without changing this lock.

revision_policy.handling: Keep old closure evidence bound to its historical snapshot. Route new sources globally, mark affected current coverage stale and queue extraction in the sole active domain or for a later knowledge turn. Publish a reviewed new snapshot before claiming updated coverage.
revision_policy.completed_domain_revision: If a closed domain gains relevant evidence while another domain is active, queue revision_pending; do not silently extend the old closure or open two knowledge domains. Commander must review delta impact and schedule a single-domain revision before any new transition.

snapshot_metadata.measurement_note: Initial scaffold, not a fresh domain evaluation. All unknown measurements remain null and gates not_closed; no implicit success from directories, legacy records or old canonical knowledge.
